bug_semantics: LiquidJS resolved template-controlled filter and tag names with bracket lookup on a prototype-inheriting registry (plain {}). Unregistered names such as valueOf therefore resolved to Object.prototype.valueOf. The filter pipeline then invoked that function as a handler with this bound to a FilterImpl object ({context, later also liquid and token}). Native valueOf returns its receiver, so {{ 1 | valueOf }} leaked engine internals (Context, Liquid, parser, loader, fs, filter table) into template data. Combined with group_by/where property extraction, assign-to-__proto__, and Comparable operators that call lhs.equals/gt/... with this equal to the current scope, a crafted template could obtain Function and execute arbitrary code. Same prototype lookup on liquid.tags made {% constructor %} bypass the missing-tag assertion. CWE-94 RCE. Affected <=10.25.7; 10.26.0 stores filters/tags with Object.create(null).
flaw_origin: The smallest first write of the advisory gadget (prototype-inherited valueOf invoked as a filter with FilterImpl as this, so valueOf returns that receiver) is 00bc1efe6a514b24b0bfc2e4196ab2211e7d9fa8 (2019-04-17, harttle). It changed Filter.render from impl.apply(null, ...) to impl.apply({ context }, ...). Immediate parent 6fb47962021bcf5ade0e2b7733883e6690da4df3 still has apply(null, ...) on src/template/filter/filter.ts, so Object.prototype.valueOf could not return a FilterImpl. The prototype-inheriting registry (filters={} / Filter.impls={} / later liquid.filters={}) is older, including the 677e8511e TypeScript class extraction and the 92992689c FilterMap-to-plain-{} refactor; those are carriers/refactors, not the first write of the this-binding that turns valueOf into a leak. f9f595f0f later put the Liquid instance on this (needed for the published parser/fs RCE PoC); d705888c8 added token. Direct fix 457fae0736c3ec862539b9dbf7f477e6c08fb6c6 (in v10.26.0, not v10.25.7) switches liquid.filters and liquid.tags to Object.create(null). Cursor co-authorship is on that fix only.

The vendor-fixed lookup (plain {} registries) is an old carrier; the first write that makes Object.prototype.valueOf return engine this is 00bc1efe6, whose parent still applies filters with this=null (valueOf cannot leak FilterImpl).
